goal: Eliminate AssumeUTXO to remove the pervasive complexity of concurrent chainstates across Bitcoin Core
Relieve developers of subtle synchronization edge cases and high cognitive load in core validation paths
reviewability: Ready to review now as an architectural reference, though rebasing onto master is needed
agreement: Concept NACK objecting that removing AssumeUTXO loses fast bootstrapping and risks user flight (Sjors)
Suggests dropping background validation first rather than removing AssumeUTXO entirely (Sjors)
Concept ACK because multiple chainstates add high maintenance costs and weaken trust assumptions (ismaelsadeeq)
Suggests keeping AssumeUTXO as an optional IPC side-process to reduce kernel maintenance burden (ariard)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because resolving concurrent chainstates removes a major architectural burden in core validation
Eliminates subtle synchronization edge cases and recurring cognitive load across critical validation paths
